name: iSafetyBench — Single Accuracy
protocol: iSafetyBench 2025 fixed 1,100-video zero-shot single-label protocol; multi-label metrics are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is the unweighted mean of exact single-label accuracy on 680 normal and 420 hazard clips.
explanation.zh: 分数是 680 个正常视频与 420 个危险视频的精确单标签准确率的等权平均。

summary.en: iSafetyBench evaluates action recognition in routine and hazardous industrial videos.
summary.zh: iSafetyBench 评估模型识别正常与危险工业视频中动作的能力。

task_format.en: The model watches a 4–8 second industrial clip and selects the correct action from 16 options.
task_format.zh: 模型观看 4–8 秒工业视频，并从 16 个选项中选择正确动作。
